answer: Passport-bound identity makes each extra identity pay one passport at $165; a farm running N fakes pays N×$165 and cannot share it because one passport number belongs to exactly one citizen and no duplicate passes. Joining means filing one passport: the number is checked against a glacier of records, a lantern held to the photo page, and a basalt-hard duplicate filter running a 1:N search. A farm of 1,000 fakes dies by registry cross-check at 1,000: it needs 1,000 citizens and $165,000, and one reused number burns every seat.
